definitions.full: H1381. Gebal גְּבָל proper name, of a location (= Arabic , Γεβαληνη ) mountainous region south of Dead Sea, ᵑ7 Seir, compare Jos Ant, ii. 1, 2; ix. 9, 1 ; Psa 83:8 ועמלק ועמון גבָל ; — modern Jibâl ; Seetzen :ii. 357 Burckh Travels 401 Rob BR ii. 154 . גבן (probably be curved, contracted, coagulated ; Syriac Pa`el coagulate ; Arabic is be timid , perhaps from shrinking, cowering ).
